oak_pallet.name: Prof. Oak
oak_pallet.dialogue_default: It's dangerous to go alone! Take these.
oak_pallet.dialogue_post_flag: How is your Pokédex coming along? Catch 'em all!

route_1_clerk.name: Shop Clerk
route_1_clerk.dialogue_default: Hi there! I'm from the Viridian City Poké Mart! I've got a free sample for trainers passing through. Here, take this!
route_1_clerk.dialogue_post_flag: Make sure to stock up on Poké Balls if you plan on catching wild Pokémon!

guard_route8.name: Thirsty Guard
guard_route8.dialogue_default: I'm so thirsty... Oh, you have a drink? Thanks! You can pass now.
guard_route8.dialogue_req_unmet: I'm so thirsty... But I can't accept just anything. Bring me a refreshing drink from the Celadon Dept. Store rooftop!
guard_route8.dialogue_post_flag: Thanks for the drink! The road to Saffron City is open.

fossil_scientist_dome.name: Lab Scientist 1
fossil_scientist_dome.dialogue_default: Ah, the Dome Fossil! I can resurrect this into Kabuto using our machine.
fossil_scientist_dome.dialogue_req_unmet: You don't have a Dome Fossil for me to work with.
fossil_scientist_dome.dialogue_post_flag: Isn't science amazing? Take good care of Kabuto.

fossil_scientist_helix.name: Lab Scientist 2
fossil_scientist_helix.dialogue_default: Ah, the Helix Fossil! I can resurrect this into Omanyte using our machine.
fossil_scientist_helix.dialogue_req_unmet: You don't have a Helix Fossil for me to work with.
fossil_scientist_helix.dialogue_post_flag: Isn't science amazing? Take good care of Omanyte.

celadon_mansion_eevee.name: Eevee Manager
celadon_mansion_eevee.dialogue_default: I've been looking for someone to take this rare Pokémon off my hands. Would you like it?
celadon_mansion_eevee.dialogue_post_flag: Make sure you evolve Eevee with the right stone to suit your team!

route4_magikarp_salesman.name: Magikarp Salesman
route4_magikarp_salesman.dialogue_default: Hello there! Have I got a deal for you! I'll let you have a magnificent Magikarp for just ¥500!
route4_magikarp_salesman.dialogue_req_unmet: You'll need ¥500 if you want to buy this incredible Pokémon!
route4_magikarp_salesman.dialogue_post_flag: No refunds! That Magikarp is a fine specimen.

ss_anne_captain.name: Captain
ss_anne_captain.dialogue_default: Urrp! I feel seasick... Oh, you want to learn how to cut trees? Take this HM01!
ss_anne_captain.dialogue_post_flag: Urrp... Thank you for rubbing my back. You can use Cut outside of battle to clear small trees.

cinnabar_lab_trade_seel.name: Super Nerd
cinnabar_lab_trade_seel.dialogue_default: I'm looking for a Ponyta. Want to trade it for my Seel?
cinnabar_lab_trade_seel.dialogue_req_unmet: Hmm, that's not a Ponyta. Bring me one if you want to trade!
cinnabar_lab_trade_seel.dialogue_post_flag: Isn't my old Seel doing great?

pewter_museum_clerk.name: Museum Guide
pewter_museum_clerk.dialogue_default: Welcome to the Pewter Museum of Science! Admission is ¥50. Would you like to enter?
pewter_museum_clerk.dialogue_req_unmet: Oops, looks like you're short on cash. Admission is ¥50!
pewter_museum_clerk.dialogue_post_flag: Enjoy looking at the fossils and space exhibit!

safari_zone_gate_attendant.name: Safari Warden
safari_zone_gate_attendant.dialogue_default: Welcome to the Safari Zone! It's ¥500 for a pass, and you get 30 Safari Balls to catch all you want.
safari_zone_gate_attendant.dialogue_req_unmet: You don't have enough money for the Safari Pass. Come back with ¥500!
safari_zone_gate_attendant.dialogue_post_flag: Keep an eye on your step count and your Safari Balls!

victory_road_guard.name: League Guard
victory_road_guard.dialogue_default: Only trainers who have proven themselves against all eight Gym Leaders can pass through to Victory Road.
victory_road_guard.dialogue_req_unmet: You don't have all eight Gym Badges yet! You need the Earth Badge and all the others to prove your strength.
victory_road_guard.dialogue_post_flag: Ah, you possess all eight Badges! Go right ahead, and good luck at the Pokémon League!

oak_pallet_dex.name: Prof. Oak
oak_pallet_dex.dialogue_default: Ah, back again! How is your Pokédex coming along? Remember, the goal is to catch all 151 Pokémon species in Kanto! Every new species brings you closer to completing it. Keep at it!

bill_maniac.name: Bill
bill_maniac.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Yikes! You startled me! I was experimenting with my teleporter and got fused with a Pokémon! ...There we go, all fixed! Thanks! Take this S.S. Ticket — the ship leaves from Vermilion City!
bill_maniac.dialogue_post_flag: [DRAFT] Enjoy your cruise! The S.S. Anne leaves from Vermilion City.

pewter_museum_scientist.name: Museum Scientist
pewter_museum_scientist.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Ah, Old Amber! Ancient resin with Pokémon DNA trapped inside. We don't have the equipment to revive it here — but the Pokémon Lab on Cinnabar Island does. Take it there!

fossil_scientist_amber.name: Lab Scientist 3
fossil_scientist_amber.dialogue_default: Ah, the Old Amber! I can resurrect this into Aerodactyl using our machine.
fossil_scientist_amber.dialogue_req_unmet: You don't have any Old Amber for me to work with.
fossil_scientist_amber.dialogue_post_flag: Isn't science amazing? Take good care of Aerodactyl.

snorlax_route12.name: Snorlax
snorlax_route12.dialogue_default: [DRAFT] Snorlax woke up with a tremendous yawn! It looks ready to battle... (Something stirs in the tall grass nearby.)
snorlax_route12.dialogue_req_unmet: [DRAFT] A huge Snorlax is fast asleep, blocking the path. It won't budge... They say a certain flute's melody can wake sleeping Pokémon.
snorlax_route12.dialogue_post_flag: [DRAFT] Snorlax is wide awake now, and seems eager to test its strength!
